reason: The pitch itself is straight and I respect that he would tell me to just use software I already pay for, but I do not buy anything from someone I have never heard of. Nobody in my circle has used Clockout, so I would be the guinea pig.
objection: I do not know a single person in town who has had Donovin in their shop and can tell me it was worth the money. A free hour still costs me an hour and a write-up I will probably file in the truck.
would_change_my_mind: A name I trust, my accountant, my equipment guy, or another owner two towns over, says they used him and it paid for itself.
